entities.name: Emil Løvlien
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emil Løvlien was a Norwegian forest worker, trade unionist and politician from Løiten Municipality. He represented the Labour Party until the split in 1923, and the Communist Party thereafter. He was the chairman of the Communist Party from 1946 to 1965, and served three terms in the Parliament of Norway.
